clippings.speaker: Trent Reznor
clippings.quote: Atticus and I both share the same aesthetic, and that's what drew us together initially…
clippings.title: LIKE: Trent Reznor & Atticus Ross Discuss Their Social Network Soundtrack
clippings.context: Interviewed about the Social Network soundtrack and how the two first came to work together.

clippings.speaker: Trent Reznor
clippings.quote: when I say we, it's my partner Atticus Ross and myself - we employed the same methodology, really, on both films.
clippings.film: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
clippings.title: Trent Reznor: The Fresh Air Interview
clippings.context: Terry Gross interview the week The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo opened, on how he and Ross worked on it and on The Social Network.

clippings.speaker: Trent Reznor
clippings.quote: a kind of forced collaboration for two guys who don’t collaborate that much outside of our own circle.
clippings.title: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross on Scoring 'Watchmen,' David Fincher, and Their Upcoming Pixar Film
clippings.context: Looking back on how their first film score with David Fincher came about, when Reznor and Ross were both scoring films.

clippings.speaker: Atticus Ross
clippings.quote: We come into the studio at those hours even if we're not working on a project, just to make music.
clippings.title: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross
clippings.context: Describing the pair's habit of working in their studio at odd hours even without a film project to score.
